species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 50°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 40–142 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 100 ft, cold below.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.

species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 50°F on top, right in their comfort range.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 100 ft, cold below.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 50°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 38–42 ft deep, mostly on drop-offs.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 100 ft, cold below.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 100 ft, cold below.
